description: Look up the registration record of any domain, live from its registry's RDAP (the successor of WHOIS): whether it is registered, the registrar, creation and expiry dates, status codes and name servers. Personal details of the holder are never returned. Links to the explained record on hivex.si.

domain.description: A domain, e.g. 'example.com' (a hostname is reduced to its domain)

name: whois_lookup
title: Look up a domain's registration (WHOIS)
